lastCompletedStory.title: Track sidecar session start and render total session elapsed in the dashboard header

nextStoryContext: US-001 (session elapsed) is done. US-002 (session-cumulative worker-token total in the header) is next and lives in the same 'Loop' SummaryPanel: read the existing per-story token-usage machinery in src/transcript/usage.ts (renderTokensLine, readWorkerSessionMarker, parseTranscriptUsage) plus the event log (.claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl, 'tokens' kind events, see readWorkerTokens in src/supervisor/events.ts) to accumulate a session-cumulative total distinct from the existing per-run 'tokens' row (which shows the CURRENT orchestrator transcript's counts, not a summed session total). The new session-start marker written in this story (src/supervisor/session-start.ts, .claude/.cam-sidecar-session.json) is the natural boundary for 'since session start' accumulation if US-002 needs one -- read it via readSidecarSessionStart(join(cwd, '.claude')) rather than re-deriving session start a second way. Mirror this story's SummaryRow placement convention (state/story/progress/since/session/tokens/branch) when adding the new cost row.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Story only reused already-established internal patterns (node:fs readFileSync/writeFileSync mirroring sidecar-pid.ts, and existing Ink Section/SummaryRow/Text components already used for the since row); no new external API surface was introduced.
